title: Austin: Airport Growth, Utility Rates, Police
summary:
*   Discussions covered acquiring land for the expanding Austin-Bergstrom International Airport.
*   Briefings were held regarding a new Utility Infrastructure Ordinance, expected to impact all city utility users.
*   The city examined electric utility revenue, rate comparisons, and the growing competition within the energy industry.
*   Proposals for re-engineering the Austin Police Department's operations were reviewed.
